launch.description: Explicit inherited-lock profile only. Retains all original independently admitted key/assignment/peer requirements. Old Persistence/v1 remains exactly two descriptors and reopens its own lock. v2 receives the original already-locked open-file-description as FD8; no unlock/reacquire handoff.

activation.description: Actual retained FD metadata signed in C9. Fixed /run/serverware-shadow-persistence/listener.sock, fresh /var/lib/serverware/native-shadow-persistence/journal and named persistence.lock. Descriptor numbers and metadata alone are not runtime ownership; the native launcher rechecks transferred FDs and service validates actual named locked inode.

genesis.description: Exact independently supplied canonical original, <=16 KiB, after real C9 delivery exists. proofScopeSha256 is the typed protected scope binding_sha256, not a fabricated digest. Guest equals the full actual signed delivery association. Producer does not generate this original.

freshJournal.description: Separately supplied canonical current-head admission <=1 KiB. Fresh producer requires headSha256==genesisSha256. No absence-derived authority, backfill, reuse, repair, nonzero imported chain or new-boot handover.

serviceAssignment.description: Explicit independently supplied existing CustodySupervisorCapability signer, distinct raw key material from C9 authority. StoreDispatchOriginal permission remains separate from read-only VerifyPersistence. Current native admission still verifies complete actual assignment/key/trust/scope originals and real peer.
